# Enterprise Morphogenesis

> White paper by Yannick Huchard (Version 1.0, August 2026). Enterprise Architecture as the morphogenetic system of the enterprise: how strategy becomes a target form, and how that form is generated, scaled, and kept viable under continuous change.

Canonical HTML: https://yannickhuchard.github.io/enterprise-morphogenesis/
Author: https://yannickhuchard.com
Source repository: https://github.com/yannickhuchard/enterprise-morphogenesis
License: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). There is no DOI.

Use the Markdown or llms-full.txt files for retrieval, RAG, custom GPTs, Claude projects, Gemini Gems, Grok, Perplexity, and Copilot.

## Full text

- [Markdown manuscript](https://yannickhuchard.github.io/enterprise-morphogenesis/index.md): complete paper; preferred structured source
- [llms-full.txt](https://yannickhuchard.github.io/enterprise-morphogenesis/llms-full.txt): complete paper as UTF-8 text
- [HTML](https://yannickhuchard.github.io/enterprise-morphogenesis/): formatted reading copy
- [Word](https://yannickhuchard.github.io/enterprise-morphogenesis/Enterprise_Morphogenesis_v1_0.docx): publication Word file
